10216|1147bc15.name: Gubber Blump
10216|1147bc15.text: ...pan fried, deep fried, and stir fried...

10219|572db4df.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
10219|572db4df.text: May Elune walk with you, $c.  The Temple of the Moon has come to help the troubled citizens of Auberdine.

11026|40d3ed3c.name: Sprite Jumpsprocket
11026|40d3ed3c.text: You need to start learning things that are beyond my expertise! Talk to Lilliam Sparkspindle in front of the tent there. He'll set you on the right course!

11867|3f5ede7c.name: Woo Ping
11867|3f5ede7c.text: Have you come seeking training in the ways of armed combat?

1302|e86e31c2.name: Bernard Gump
1302|e86e31c2.text: We are the only supplier of healthy flowers in all of Stormwind. We provide beautiful blooms for any occasion.

1325|e69bef2b.name: Jasper Fel
1325|e69bef2b.text: Speak quietly and with great care, the wrong word in these parts could get your throat cut. Now, what is it you need from me?

13283|a0b51800.name: Lord Tony Romano
13283|a0b51800.text: You look like the type I should watch my coin purse around. Something I can help you with?

1351|a96dc031.name: Brother Cassius
1351|a96dc031.text: May the light guide your path and aid you in your journies. If you need any assistance browsing, I will be right over here.

1571|c5ceacbe.name: Shellei Brondir
1571|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

1646|1d2a2e75.name: Baros Alexston
1646|1d2a2e75.text: Greetings, I am Baros Alexston, City Architect of Stormwind.

2327|2957a3a0.name: Shaina Fuller
2327|2957a3a0.text: Oh, a fellow Physician. I would be glad to teach you anything that would aid your journeys.

233|f729d74e.name: Farmer Saldean
233|f729d74e.text: Rough times, huh, $N? No matter where you turn someone needs help, and my wife and I are no exception.

234|eba492ed.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
234|eba492ed.text: A foul corruption has crept into Westfall.  While I was upholding my duty on the battlefields of Lordaeron these honest farms were overrun and made into hide-outs for thugs and murderers. The People's Militia needs your help.

235|f83ef93f.name: Salma Saldean
235|f83ef93f.text: Welcome to our humble abode!  It's always nice to see a friendly face.  And what strong arms you have.  My husband and I are always looking for help around the farm.  Now that most the good folk have left, it's hard to find an able body to help out.

2432|c5ceacbe.name: Darla Harris
2432|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2455|105cd232.name: Olivia Burnside
2455|105cd232.text: No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!

2456|2237a3b1.name: Newton Burnside
2456|2237a3b1.text: Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us sir?

2457|105cd232.name: John Burnside
2457|105cd232.text: No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!

2457|2237a3b1.name: John Burnside
2457|2237a3b1.text: Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us sir?

2485|1c7cd7a4.name: Larimaine Purdue
2485|1c7cd7a4.text: I do not believe you possess the mental acuity to grasp the nature of portal magic.

253092|e0247c5d.name: Alba Fairmoon
253092|e0247c5d.text:
I am told the farms of Westfall once supplied a bounty of crops for Stormwind. But now, the soil is barren and most of the farmers have fled.

On behalf of Darnassus I would like to offer my aid in replenishing this land. Will you assist me?

268511|ee845bad.name: Manifest Clerk Philmor
268511|ee845bad.text: Harbor work is open to everyone, but your personal safety is your own responsibility.

2835|c5ceacbe.name: Cedrik Prose
2835|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

352|4946c28b.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|4946c28b.text: Where is it ye would like to go lad? For just a few coin my Gryphons can get ye there faster than even the swiftest horse.

352|c23f1156.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|c23f1156.text: These great beasts know paths that ye can't find on foot, they'll get ye there fast and maybe show ye something new at the same time.

3616|29aa26bd.name: Onu
3616|29aa26bd.text:
The wind whispers to those who listen...

Do you hear it?

3649|17d06d6c.name: Thundris Windweaver
3649|17d06d6c.text: Dark forces encroach upon our borders, ancient taints resurface, and new evils emerge to topple the delicate balance of the land. In times of such darkness, we all must be vigilant.

3691|3e6c050b.name: Raene Wolfrunner
3691|3e6c050b.text: I know these forests as if they were a part of me... But know that there is still much to be learned from them, and much danger still hidden.

3692|6e5dc9aa.name: Volcor
3692|6e5dc9aa.text:
Well, the way I see it, $N, we have two options to consider for leaving this cave.

We can make our way stealthfully--I use the cloak you've given me, and you'd be left to your own devices, or, and this may be a harder option considering my wounds, we fight our way out back to back.

I'll let you decide since you know your strengths better than I.

3692|966370fe.name: Volcor
3692|966370fe.text:
<Volcor doesn't look at you at all as you get close to him. He seems to be concentrating on keeping his bandages from falling off. After a moment, he looks up at you, a little startled.>

Oh, sorry, $c. Now's not a good time. I hope you understand.

3693|85fc41cc.name: Terenthis
3693|85fc41cc.text:
$N, I've come to find out how rampant the effects of Fel Moss are throughout Darkshore. The corruption of Teldrassil and our surrounding lands really concerns the druids of the Cenarian Circle, and all Night elves.

It is my goal to find out why this has happened and to put an end to it.

3838|43c9021b.name: Vesprystus
3838|43c9021b.text: To maintain our link to the mainland, we have hippogryphs constantly flying between Rut'theran Village and Darkshore.

3841|ab4871bb.name: Caylais Moonfeather
3841|ab4871bb.text: The Hippogryph is a noble beast, proud and swift.  They are an honor to train, and can quickly take their rider a great distance.

4163|2ae1d72b.name: Syurna
4163|2ae1d72b.text: Greetings young $c. What do you seek?

4200|c2e88775.name: Laird
4200|c2e88775.text: Although the coast of Darkshore is more dangerous than that of Teldrassil, many fishers find profit here.

4214|2ae1d72b.name: Erion Shadewhisper
4214|2ae1d72b.text: Greetings young $c. What do you seek?

4267|c5ceacbe.name: Daelyshia
4267|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

483|ed056522.name: Elaine Trias
483|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

483|fe52f4ea.name: Elaine Trias
483|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

523|d6469a91.name: Thor
523|d6469a91.text: Where are you going?  Well if you're looking to get there quickly, then look no further!

5493|e332eb6d.name: Arnold Leland
5493|e332eb6d.text: Ah, a fellow Fisherman. Are you perhaps in need of a little training? Maybe I can show you a thing or two?

5509|211be282.name: Kathrum Axehand
5509|211be282.text: Don't let the humans in the Bazaar fool ye lad, with the subway those gnomes built it's easier than ye might think to transport goods from Ironforge. If they try to tack on import fees just tell them yer gonna buy yer gear from me.

5512|211be282.name: Kaita Deepforge
5512|211be282.text: Don't let the humans in the Bazaar fool ye lad, with the subway those gnomes built it's easier than ye might think to transport goods from Ironforge. If they try to tack on import fees just tell them yer gonna buy yer gear from me.

5513|451d1c98.name: Gelman Stonehand
5513|451d1c98.text: I came from Ironforge to help out with the rebuilding effort here. If I can teach enough of ye my skills then maybe I can leave it to ye and take myself back home.

5518|741f51fb.name: Lilliam Sparkspindle
5518|741f51fb.text: Quid pro quo! I'll teach you what I know, but first I want you to perform a small task...

5519|3d4f7092.name: Billibub Cogspinner
5519|3d4f7092.text: If you insert tab A into slot B then of course it's going to go BOOM! Here, let me show you what I have and then you can ask Lilliam about how to put it together so it doesn't blow up.

6301|7a1efc7f.name: Gorbold Steelhand
6301|7a1efc7f.text: Greetings lad, if you're looking for the best deals you'll find outside of Ironforge itself, then you've come to the right place.

656|eb6991e6.name: Wilder Thistlenettle
656|eb6991e6.text:
There were thieves everywhere! 

It was horrible.  The cave came down on us.  I think the mining company is all dead, including my brother, the Foreman.

6737|41276936.name: Innkeeper Shaussiy
6737|41276936.text: Your body looks worn and your spirit weary. Rest yourself beneath our roof and allow Elune to guide your dreams.

6946|baa58efa.name: Renzik "The Shiv"
6946|baa58efa.text: Mathias found me left for dead by the Venture Co. in the Barrens. Had it not been for him, I'd have been prowler fodder.

7232|e03d94ba.name: Borgus Steelhand
7232|e03d94ba.text: Can't ye see I'm busy? This had better be good.

8931|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Heather
8931|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

918|a0b51800.name: Osborne the Night Man
918|a0b51800.text: You look like the type I should watch my coin purse around. Something I can help you with?

931|c5ceacbe.name: Ariena Stormfeather
931|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

1003-complete.name: Unknown
1003-complete.text:
"Sho yash gotsh the scalps in? That'sh sho great... Wha? Well, yesh I shuppose ya have realized that I can speaksh to ya without the materials in the machine. But I was telling the truth when I shaid they were broken!

See, in addition to being communimacation toolsh, the Buzzboxes also brew and distill fine liquor. Shorry for any deceptshion, but the nightelves do not apprecimerate my liquor trade in their townsh. I put shomething special in thish box to show my gratitude for yer effortsh. Enjoy!"
1003-complete.title: Buzzbox 525

1003-progress.name: Unknown
1003-progress.text:
You hear singing coming from Buzzbox 525.

"Though crawler wine's shweet, and thresher ale fine, and moonstalker moonshine ish grand. There's nothing sho dear, as a thistle bear beer, and shoon I shall have shome on hand!"

The hatch is open and awaits the 4 grizzled scalps as you hear the song repeated over and over.
1003-progress.title: Buzzbox 525

102-complete.name: Captain Danuvin
102-complete.text: Well done, $N.  With valiant adventurers such as yourself fighting alongside The People's Militia, Westfall just might return to the prosperous breadbasket it once was.  Please accept this in recognition of your tireless efforts.
102-complete.title: Patrolling Westfall

102-progress.name: Captain Danuvin
102-progress.text: Have you collected 8 paws from those treacherous Gnolls yet?
102-progress.title: Patrolling Westfall

1138-complete.name: Gubber Blump
1138-complete.text:
Wow, these fine crab chunks are what I need.  Thanks $N!  I found this while I was fishing a while ago, and I have no use for it.  Maybe you can do something with it.  It sure don't make any good crab dishes.

I told you all about crabs, right?
1138-complete.title: Fruit of the Sea

1138-progress.name: Gubber Blump
1138-progress.text:
...lemon crab, whipper root crab, and Ironforge surprise crab.  That's about it.

Oh, hello there $N.  Do you have them fine crab chunks I was telling you about?
1138-progress.title: Fruit of the Sea

12-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
12-complete.text: Well done, $N.  My scout witnessed your valiant acts.  You are proving yourself quite well so far.
12-complete.title: The People's Militia

13-accept.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
13-accept.text:
A band of vicious Defias Pillagers has been seen plundering the Gold Coast Quarry, Moonbrook and the Alexston Farmstead.  The People's Militia will not stand for such behavior.  Dispatch immediately, $N, and make the Light's presence known in Westfall.

The Gold Coast Quarry is near the shore, to the West of the tower.  As the next step of your training, I want you to kill 15 of those foul Defias Pillagers and 15 Defias Looters.
13-accept.title: The People's Militia

151-complete.name: Verna Furlbrow
151-complete.text: Thank you so much, $N!  Poor Old Blanchy will be so happy!
151-complete.title: Poor Old Blanchy

151-progress.name: Verna Furlbrow
151-progress.text: Old Blanchy is on her last leg.  Did you happen to find any oats for her?
151-progress.title: Poor Old Blanchy

153-complete.name: Scout Galiaan
153-complete.text: Nice work, $r.  Please accept one of these items as payment for all your hard work.
153-complete.title: Red Leather Bandanas

153-progress.name: Scout Galiaan
153-progress.text: Bring me 15 red leather bandanas and I'll pay you well.
153-progress.title: Red Leather Bandanas

1579-complete.name: Wizbang Cranktoggle
1579-complete.text: I can't believe you found them!  You must be the luckiest $r in Kalimdor!
1579-complete.title: Gaffer Jacks

1579-progress.name: Wizbang Cranktoggle
1579-progress.text: Did you find my gaffer jacks, $N?  Without my gaffer jacks I can't tune my stintle pegs!
1579-progress.title: Gaffer Jacks

1580-accept.name: Wizbang Cranktoggle
1580-accept.text:
We know you're lucky, but... just how lucky are you, $N?

One night I was wandering the roads of Darkshore.  I was looking for a good river or lake to try my new self-propelled, exploding duck decoy and I think I was a little tipsy... because I passed out and awoke hours later in Auberdine.  My hair was singed and my bag of electropellers was gone!  I must have dropped them in the water!

I need those electropellers!  Maybe you can fish them out of some lake or stream in Darkshore...
1580-accept.title: Electropellers

1580-complete.name: Wizbang Cranktoggle
1580-complete.text:
I can't believe it!  You found them!  You are the best fisherman I've ever seen!

Thank you, $N.  And here, take these.  Although you're so good and you probably don't need them, they will help you with your fishing.
1580-complete.title: Electropellers

1580-progress.name: Wizbang Cranktoggle
1580-progress.text: Did you find any electropellers?  I'll need them if I'm to continue my research on duck decoys...
1580-progress.title: Electropellers

167-accept.name: Wilder Thistlenettle
167-accept.text:
We were deep in a vast mine in Westfall, hidden beneath a barn in Moonbrook. No clue where these stinkin' thieving types came from. Anyway, the mine tunnel collapsed on us. I got out but the others... well... the others haven't been heard from.

You look like you might have better luck in there. If you could look for my brother, I'd be thankful.  He always carried his Explorers' League Badge. If you can't find him, that badge would at least give me some peace of mind.
167-accept.title: Oh Brother...

168-accept.name: Wilder Thistlenettle
168-accept.text: Many of my friends perished that horrible day when the mine tunnel caved in.  If your adventures happen to bring you into that wing of the mine in Moonbrook, please keep an eye out for any sign which might identify them.  If you come across any of their Miners' Union Cards, bring them back to me and I'll make sure their families get some resolution from this horrible accident.
168-accept.title: Collecting Memories

2040-accept.name: Shoni the Shilent
2040-accept.text:
Gnomeregan has fallen under the control of those dastardly troggs! The situation is grave but perhaps you can help, $N.

Deep in the Deadmines is a functional goblin shredder. Find that shredder and bring back the intact power supply. With the shredder's power supply, we can give our gyrodrillmatic excavationators the power they need to break through the rocky underground borders of Gnomeregan, opening the way for a gnomish assault!
2040-accept.title: Underground Assault

2040-complete.name: Shoni the Shilent
2040-complete.text: Well done, $N. Thanks to you, Gnomeregan is one step closer to its day of liberation!
2040-complete.title: Underground Assault

2040-progress.name: Shoni the Shilent
2040-progress.text: Have you found the Gnoam Sprecklesprocket, $N?
2040-progress.title: Underground Assault

2078-accept.name: Gelkak Gyromast
2078-accept.text:
Landlubber, ye needs to find me first mate.

Take this'n key, puts it in his gulliver an' bring him back here to serve the Cap'n.

Them murlocs an' their chief ain't gonna be too happy once me first mate gets a hold of em!
2078-accept.title: Gyromast's Revenge

2078-complete.name: Gelkak Gyromast
2078-complete.text:
Yarrr... Ye be provin' yerself to be more than a yella sea dog, landlubber.

The Cap'n may promote ye to poop deck swabby if ye be keepin' this up...
2078-complete.title: Gyromast's Revenge

2098-accept.name: Gelkak Gyromast
2098-accept.text:
A pirate's life ain't an easy one, landlubber. It ain't all about plunderin' and booze! Alas, me ship be sunk just off shore thanks to them pesky Threshadons.

What I be needin' is me first mate back in workin' order!

When I washed up'n shore, the key for me first mate broke on the rocks and was pilfered by the beasties of Darkshore. Out of the corner of me eyes I saw some of them Ragin' Crawlers, Ferocious Foreststrider, and murloc rummaging through the wreckage....
2098-accept.title: Gyromast's Retrieval

2098-complete.name: Gelkak Gyromast
2098-complete.text:
Avast ye scurvy sea dog! Ye did it! Soon me first mate be back in workin' order and them beasties won't know what hit em!

Hrm, have ye seen me first mate?
2098-complete.title: Gyromast's Retrieval

2098-progress.name: Gelkak Gyromast
2098-progress.text: Have ye found me broke down key, landlubber?
2098-progress.title: Gyromast's Retrieval

2139-complete.name: Tharnariun Treetender
2139-complete.text:
You have fought for Auberdine with bravery and honor, $N. In our war torn lands, death and despair are common. Many will not rise to meet the challenge of life in our new home, choosing instead to hide in their homes or escape to the more fortified lands of the Alliance.

Thank you, $N. Perhaps someday soon we shall fight along side as comrades versus another foe.
2139-complete.title: Tharnariun's Hope

2260-accept.name: Erion Shadewhisper
2260-accept.text:
Word of your deeds has spread far and wide, $N. So far, in fact, that Stormwind Intelligence has asked for you by name.

The journey is taxing and not without peril, but an opportunity to train under SI:7 should not be taken lightly.

A new world awaits you, $N. Make your way to Old Town in Stormwind and speak with Renzik "The Shiv" at SI:7 headquarters.
2260-accept.title: Erion's Behest

2260-complete.name: Renzik "The Shiv"
2260-complete.text: You have answered SI:7's calling, $N and journeyed from distant shores to join our ranks, however, there is much for you to learn.
2260-complete.title: Erion's Behest

2281-accept.name: Renzik "The Shiv"
2281-accept.text:
Sending you out in the field now would be suicide. Renzik doesn't need another dead $c on his hands. Don't fret, though, $N - Renzik is going to get you up to speed.

Make your way to the Redridge Mountains and speak with an associate of SI:7 named Lucius. You will find him hanging around the docks of Lakeshire with the other shady good-for-nothings.
2281-accept.title: Redridge Rendezvous

2281-complete.name: Lucius
2281-complete.text: Ah, so your fingers are a little fat, eh? Don't worry, $N, I've turned more useless thieves than you into accomplished rogues.
2281-complete.title: Redridge Rendezvous

2282-accept.name: Lucius
2282-accept.text:
We've been training thieves here for years! After all, not every rapscallion is born with the grace and finesse of old Lucius.

Up off the road here you'll find Alther's Mill. I got a chest up there with something important inside. Go get it for me! Bring back that token and you'll receive your Certificate of Thievery!
2282-accept.title: Alther's Mill

2282-complete.name: Lucius
2282-complete.text:
Cracked it open, did you? Nice work, $N.

If you die now, we can rest easy knowing it was due to your own stupidity and not inexperience.
2282-complete.title: Alther's Mill

2282-progress.name: Lucius
2282-progress.text:
Did I forget to mention the orcs?

I hear they have been nosing around up by the mill.
2282-progress.title: Alther's Mill

2359-accept.name: Agent Kearnen
2359-accept.text:
I've been staking out this tower for weeks, $N. Recently a major shipment came through from Duskwood, and along with it came those guards.

What are they? Your guess is as good as mine. I can tell you one thing - they aren't human.

Anyhow, the shipment had a chest - which is what I assume those abominations are guarding. The zombie with the spikes holds a key we'll need.

Get that key, get in the tower, and uncover whatever is in that chest. Take your findings back to Mathias.
2359-accept.title: Klaven's Tower

2359-complete.name: Master Mathias Shaw
2359-complete.text:
This would explain the Defias drones you and Kearnen saw outside of the tower, $N. It would also explain the Venture Company's involvement with the Defias and the strange shipments out of Duskwood.

According to this book, the Zanzil trolls in Stranglethorn have discovered a way to raise the dead through potions... or to be more specific: poison.

You'll be of no use to SI:7 without a firm understanding of poisons, $N -- especially with the recipe to create undeath at our fingertips.
2359-complete.title: Klaven's Tower

2360-accept.name: Master Mathias Shaw
2360-accept.text:
Not a moment too soon, $N. SI:7 reconnaissance is reporting unusually heavy Defias activity in Westfall.

It would seem that the Defias have taken over an abandoned Alliance watch tower southeast of Sentinel Hill and are using it as a base of operations to smuggle in goods from the Redridge supply route.

Get to Westfall and contact Agent Kearnen for your debriefing. You will find her hidden near the tower.

...and $N, should you be discovered, SI:7 will disavow all knowledge of your existence.
2360-accept.title: Mathias and the Defias

2360-complete.name: Agent Kearnen
2360-complete.text: Mathias finally sent another agent to back me up, eh? Well I hope he's ready to hear some bad news.
2360-complete.title: Mathias and the Defias

2607-accept.name: Master Mathias Shaw
2607-accept.text:
It appears as if you've brought back more information than even I expected. This certainly is a strange turn of events, $N.

A cure? Hrm... Go down to the cellar and speak with Doc Mixilpixil - he may be able to help.
2607-accept.title: The Touch of Zanzil

2607-complete.name: Doc Mixilpixil
2607-complete.text: It's about time! Just put the cheese on the table and skedaddle. Osborne will pay you on the way out.
2607-complete.title: The Touch of Zanzil

2608-accept.name: Doc Mixilpixil
2608-accept.text:
Oh my, you look like death. Correction - I've seen death, you look worse than death. You, sir, would be what death coughed up at his last physical.

Hah! You hear that Noarm? Write that one down!

*Cough* Hrm yes, in order for me to help you, I'll need to draw some blood. Don't worry, it only hurts the first few... fifty times or so... /lay down when you're ready for the treatment, $N.
2608-accept.title: The Touch of Zanzil

2608-complete.name: Doc Mixilpixil
2608-complete.text: Give me a moment to confer with my colleagues, $N. Dr. Montgomery, Mr. Noarm, let us conference!
2608-complete.title: The Touch of Zanzil

2609-accept.name: Doc Mixilpixil
2609-accept.text:
It's unanimous, $N. You've got the 'itis.'

Luckily, I have a cure for the 'itis.'

Here's what I need: One bundle of simple wildflowers, one leaded vial, one bronze tube, and last but certainly not least, one spool of light chartreuse silk thread. Ol' Emma left a spool of it for me at 'The Finest Thread.' You can find the shop along the canals.

Hurry along now, $N, and try not to touch anyone until you're cured. Oh, and Dr. Montgomery says you need a shower -- his words, not mine.
2609-accept.title: The Touch of Zanzil

2609-complete.name: Doc Mixilpixil
2609-complete.text:
What am I doing? What does it look like I'm doing? I'm devising a cure for your 'itis!' Don't get indignant with me now, $N!

Just a few more seconds. There! Just spray this, um, fantastic smelling medicine on yourself and you'll be as good as new.
2609-complete.title: The Touch of Zanzil

2609-progress.name: Doc Mixilpixil
2609-progress.text: If you want the 'itis' cured, you're going to have to try harder than that, $N. Where are the reagents for the cure?
2609-progress.title: The Touch of Zanzil

2923-accept.name: Brother Sarno
2923-accept.text:
Tinkmaster Overspark is very upset with the fate of his mechanical creation, Techbot.  I remember Techbot as a kind and helpful tool for the gnomes, but Overspark tells me it's malfunctioned.

Very sad.  But with luck perhaps he can be fixed!

Speak with Tinkmaster Overspark, in Tinker Town in Ironforge.  He would welcome your help.
2923-accept.title: Tinkmaster Overspark

2928-accept.name: Shoni the Shilent
2928-accept.text:
It's terrible, $N. We are not going to have enough parts to get our fleet of gyrodrillmatic excavationators to Dun Morogh.

What we need are spare parts, $N. What better place to get the spare parts for our vehicles than Gnomeregan? I hear that bots and mechs roam around that place like cattle on an open range.

What I need you to do is go to Gnomeregan and tear apart those robots. Bring me back their robot guts. Two dozen should be sufficient.
2928-accept.title: Gyrodrillmatic Excavationators

343-accept.name: Brother Kristoff
343-accept.text:
I'm giving a speech on the Fortitude of the Spirit, and I'd like to recite passages from a particular book on metallurgy - "The Stresses of Iron."  A copy of this book should be in the Royal Library, within Stormwind Keep.  Can you retrieve it for me?  If so, then may the blessings of the Light be with you!

The Royal Library is very large, but the head librarian, Milton Sheaf, knows each shelf like it was his own son.  Speak to him, he'll retrieve the book for you.
343-accept.title: Speaking of Fortitude

373-accept.name: Unknown
373-accept.text:
Searching Edwin VanCleef's person, you discover, among other things, an unsent letter. It is addressed to Baros Alexston, the City Architect of Stormwind, City Hall, Cathedral Square.

It appears to be recently written and sealed.
373-accept.title: The Unsent Letter

373-complete.name: Baros Alexston
373-complete.text:
Edwin VanCleef, you say? I would as much expect a letter from my dead grandmother... So you've killed him then? Pardon me in saying, but I'm somewhat surprised. He was a peerless fighter in his younger years. Let's see what he finds the need to write to me about after so many years.

<Baros peruses the letter.>

Edwin... I see the years haven't changed you a bit, an idealist as ever, and a romantic. He doesn't care who he hurts, $N. Revenge has consumed him. But then, I'm not sure I can blame him.
373-complete.title: The Unsent Letter

373-progress.name: Baros Alexston
373-progress.text: Yes? Is there something I can help you with?
373-progress.title: The Unsent Letter

38-complete.name: Salma Saldean
38-complete.text: That Okra will thicken up this broth nicely!  Now we just add the Stringy Vulture Meat, a few Murloc Eyes and those delicious Goretusk Snouts.  And we're done!  For all your help, $N, I want you to take today's first batch of Westfall Stew!
38-complete.title: Westfall Stew

38-progress.name: Salma Saldean
38-progress.text:
Come back with the following ingredients: 
 
 3 Stringy Vulture Meat 
 3 Goretusk Snouts 
 3 Murloc Eyes 
 3 Okra
38-progress.title: Westfall Stew

388-accept.name: Nikova Raskol
388-accept.text:
Bitterness flows through my veins like a cold river.  My grandson, Mac, was such a good boy.  A mere 14 years old.  When the army was sent off to the front, Mac took up arms to defend the city.  He was a guard in The Stockade, where the Defias gang is locked up.  Mac reprimanded some of the prisoners for tearing their wool blankets to make scarves, a symbol of their gang.  For that Mac was stabbed in the back.

I want revenge.  Bring me 10 of their precious Wool Bandanas.  They are the color of blood.
388-accept.title: The Color of Blood

389-accept.name: Baros Alexston
389-accept.text:
VanCleef and I were members of the Stonemasons Guild. Our main project was to rebuild Stormwind after the War.

When we had finished our duties, we were cheated. The nobles refused to pay us for our work. Some of the more senior of the Stonemasons were offered governmental jobs, but VanCleef refused it out of loyalty to all the Stonemasons. He led a riot and left the city, swearing revenge.

His lieutenant, Bazil Thredd, might know more about VanCleef's plans. He's being held prisoner in the Stockade.
389-accept.title: Bazil Thredd

4727-accept.name: Unknown
4727-accept.text: The skeletal remains of a sea turtle lie in the sand of the northern Darkshore beaches.  The Greymist murlocs have either not found this carcass, or perhaps they have and are shying away from it for some unknown reason.  Regardless, there is enough of the turtle left to take a sample back to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine for the Temple of the Moon to study.
4727-accept.title: Beached Sea Turtle

4727-complete.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4727-complete.text: It is interesting that the murlocs were not present at this site; we will keep this in mind as we study this creature's remains!  Thank you for your effort, $N; the Temple of the Moon would like for me to give you this, as compensation for your time.
4727-complete.title: Beached Sea Turtle

4727-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4727-progress.text: Hello once again $N - have you found any more beached creatures that the Temple of the Moon should know about?
4727-progress.title: Beached Sea Turtle

4728-accept.name: Unknown
4728-accept.text: The corpse of what appears to be some sort of giant sea mammal lies partially gutted on the beach.  A wheelbarrow and various tools lie abandoned by this enormous beached sea creature, as though an attempt to study it had been made previously.  Though murlocs have scavenged this beast, enough of it remains to gather a suitable sample for Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.
4728-accept.title: Beached Sea Creature

4728-complete.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4728-complete.text: Ah, I believe you discovered one that was originally being examined by the Explorer's League.  They have a presence here in Darkshore, and they had mentioned that they were studying one of the beached creatures until they were chased out by the murlocs.  You appear to have succeeded where we both have not.  Please - accept this honorarium on behalf of the Temple of the Moon.
4728-complete.title: Beached Sea Creature

4728-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4728-progress.text: Greetings once again, $N!  What brings you back to Auberdine?  Are you here to report on another discovery, perhaps?
4728-progress.title: Beached Sea Creature

4730-accept.name: Unknown
4730-accept.text: The half-devoured corpse of what might have been a giant sea mammal lies on the beach.  A band of murlocs, stronger than those found closer to Auberdine, have taken up residence around the fallen creature.  Enough of the creature remains that a suitable sample of its bones could be delivered to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.
4730-accept.title: Beached Sea Creature

4730-complete.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4730-complete.text:
The bones you have are from gentle sea mammals that are known to inhabit the waters surrounding the base of Teldrassil.  They had never been known to violently beach themselves like the threshers had been known to.  Why would these creatures do this, I wonder?  Well, perhaps the study of their remains will bear the fruits of knowledge that we seek.

Again, thank you for your aid.  Please accept this honorarium from the Temple of the Moon.
4730-complete.title: Beached Sea Creature

4730-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4730-progress.text: Hello again, $N!  Are you here to report on another discovery?
4730-progress.title: Beached Sea Creature

4731-accept.name: Unknown
4731-accept.text:
Another set of sea turtle remains lie beached on the coastline.  This set of remains has an abandoned carriage half buckled to the turtle's shell.  Perhaps this creature was driven to the shoreline by unknown beings rather than beaching itself as some of the other remains suggested.  Powerful Greymist murlocs have made the carcass of this creature their current home.

In the carriage, you find a box with strange markings on it; perhaps Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine can make sense of it.
4731-accept.title: Beached Sea Turtle

4731-complete.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4731-complete.text:
I have heard of the kinds of carriages found on the back of that turtle.  Those I do believe are naga carriages, used both in battle and in transportation of their supplies on to land.  The markings on the box you found are of the naga; perhaps the creature you discovered was killed as it was heading further south... to Ashenvale maybe?

I will be sure to send this box to Darnassus with the rest of your discoveries.  This is for you - thank you again for your assistance.
4731-complete.title: Beached Sea Turtle

4731-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4731-progress.text: Hello again, $N.  The work you have done on behalf of the Temple of the Moon has been outstanding.  Are we to be blessed with more of your effort on our behalf?
4731-progress.title: Beached Sea Turtle

4732-accept.name: Unknown
4732-accept.text: You find a corpse of a sea turtle that had beached itself on the coast of Darkshore some time ago.  It has been picked nearly clean by Greymist murlocs, the very ones who now have encamped themselves around the creature's remains.  Still, there appear to be some suitable samples left on the creature's remains that Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine might be able to make use of.
4732-accept.title: Beached Sea Turtle

4732-complete.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4732-complete.text:
You've found even more beached creatures, $N?  Sea turtles were commonly found frolicking along the base of Nordrassil before it was destroyed.  With the birth of Teldrassil, however, these creatures have been seen in ever decreasing numbers.  Some, as we have discovered, end their lives here for some unknown reason.

Your aid will perhaps unlock the mystery before us.  Please accept this in exchange for the remains you have provided for our study.
4732-complete.title: Beached Sea Turtle

4732-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4732-progress.text: Greetings once again $N - do you have any more discoveries to report to the Temple of the Moon?
4732-progress.title: Beached Sea Turtle

4733-accept.name: Unknown
4733-accept.text:
The remains of what appear to be a giant thresher have washed ashore on the rocky inlet of the Twilight Shore.  The thresher is several times larger than any of the other threshers spotted in these parts.  Wherever it came from, this creature would not seem to have been native to Darkshore.

Though the creature has been picked apart in places, enough of it remains to gather a suitable sample for Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.
4733-accept.title: Beached Sea Creature

4733-complete.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4733-complete.text:
The dimensions of the thresher you mention are mind-boggling.  Even the eldest of the threshers in this region grow to only a fraction of that size.  While some larger ones were known to be close to Teldrassil, their numbers have declined steadily.  I cannot help but wonder if these creatures beaching themselves here are somehow related to this.

While we analyze the bones you have brought us, please accept this on behalf of the Temple of the Moon.  Thank you, $N.
4733-complete.title: Beached Sea Creature

4733-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4733-progress.text: Thanks be to Elune - I am glad to see you again, dear $N.  The Temple of the Moon's work on the strange beaching phenomena continues here in Darkshore.  Might you have anything additional to offer us?
4733-progress.title: Beached Sea Creature

4740-complete.name: Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea
4740-complete.text:
Well, looks like you're here to more than just inquire!  The citizens will be delighted to know that tonight they will sleep a little bit more soundly and safer.

You've acted as the executioner of justice for the people of Auberdine today, $N.  For that, I would like to offer you this as a suitable reward... for a true hero of the Auberdine people.
4740-complete.title: WANTED: Murkdeep!

4763-complete.name: Thundris Windweaver
4763-complete.text: We have just begun this war to reclaim our forest from the forces of corruption, but a battle this day has been won!  $N, the people of Auberdine owe you a debt of gratitude that will never be easily repaid.  Please accept this along with our thanks.  What we have learned here today may one day free our furbolg friends from the shackles of torment permanently.
4763-complete.title: The Blackwood Corrupted

4763-progress.name: Thundris Windweaver
4763-progress.text: The Talisman of Corruption is a sinister device that only serves to pervert the balance of nature.  When you obtain this item from whatever satyr is tormenting the furbolgs and bring it to me for disposal, we will have won a great victory this day!
4763-progress.title: The Blackwood Corrupted

64-complete.name: Farmer Furlbrow
64-complete.text:
My watch!  Thank you so much, kind sir! 

We are but poor farmers and we have lost our land but please accept this reward as a token of our appreciation.
64-complete.title: The Forgotten Heirloom

64-progress.name: Farmer Furlbrow
64-progress.text: Don't suppose you were able to get my watch?
64-progress.title: The Forgotten Heirloom

65-accept.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
65-accept.text:
The band of wretches responsible for driving the good people of Westfall from the land call themselves The Defias Brotherhood.  I need you to infiltrate this clan of thugs.  We need to know who heads up the cartel and where they are hiding out.  In Lakeshire, in the inn, there is a $c by the name of Wiley who owes me a favor.

Travel to Lakeshire in the Redridge Mountains, east of Elwynn, and find out what you can.
65-accept.title: The Defias Brotherhood

78261-accept.name: Unknown
78261-accept.text:
<A note sits in the chest>

Hello, $N.

I desire a treasure known as The Horn of Xelthos, which is somewhere within Shadowfang Keep.

Venturing inside the keep usually calls for backup. However, for this job, a low profile is of utmost importance.

You must go alone.

I have a contact, by the name of Veenix, in the Stonetalon Mountains. He should be able to help you get past the courtyard gate. The rest is up to you. 

Return the horn here, and your payment will be sent soon after.

- C
78261-accept.title: The Horn of Xelthos

79093-complete.name: Garion Wendell
79093-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.

If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
79093-complete.title: Rumi of Gnomeregan: The Collected Works

79093-progress.name: Garion Wendell
79093-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
79093-progress.title: Rumi of Gnomeregan: The Collected Works

87760-accept.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
87760-accept.text:
I have received word back from Darnassus, $N!

From the animal samples, we learned that the naga dominated these sea creatures to use as unwilling mounts and beasts of burden. The ones that were too obstinate, or too old or badly injured, they drove out for sport. Monstrous!

It is our sacred duty to put a stop to this!

The naga have forces in the Ruins of Mathystra, and they must be seizing threshers from off the shore. Find their beastmistress, slay her, and bring back her tools of domination!
87760-accept.title: Holy Diver

9-complete.name: Farmer Saldean
9-complete.text: Good work, friend.  You have earned your pay well.  Who knows, perhaps Westfall will prosper once again.
9-complete.title: The Killing Fields

92742-accept.name: Alba Fairmoon
92742-accept.text:
We must determine the source and nature of the poison corrupting this land. Let us begin with the groundwater under the farms in the area.

Go to the Jansen Stead in the north and the Molsen Farm northwest of here, and collect samples from the wells there.
92742-accept.title: Testing the Wells

92744-accept.name: Alba Fairmoon
92744-accept.text:
The corruption affecting Westfall's crops may have seeped into the ocean as well. If the local fish are affected too, it could doom Stormwind to famine.
Collect gills from the murlocs along the shoreline and bring them to me. Murlocs are quite hardy, but their physiology is extremely sensitive to contaminants. Any toxins in the seawater will be readily apparent in the gills you find.
92744-accept.title: Murloc Gills

92909-accept.name: Ozwin Ironsprocket
92909-accept.text:
Oh no... I'm in for it now!

I heard about the harvesters terrorizing the fields of Westfall, so I traveled all the way from Ironforge to see if I could recalibrate them. But they're far more aggressive than my calculations anticipated, and they chased me into this stable!

If I had some isosprings and gyrostabilizers from the harvesters, I could build a device to cover my escape. Could you gather the parts for me?
92909-accept.title: Harvesting the Harvesters

92910-accept.name: Unknown
92910-accept.text: The part you managed to salvage from the harvester appears mostly intact. Someone interested in harvest golems may want to see it.
92910-accept.title: Harvesting the Harvesters

92911-accept.name: Ozwin Ironsprocket
92911-accept.text:
I see... this gives me some insight into what makes those monsters tick. I have an idea how we could override their systems, at least momentarily.

I'll continue tinkering with the assembly you brought me. In the meantime, could you scrounge up some parts for the device?
92911-accept.title: Harvesting the Harvesters

944-accept.name: Onu
944-accept.text:
It is strange that the naga are here, in Darkshore.  But stranger still...are the Twilight's Hammer.  That cult worships the old, old lords of the earth.  Lords defeated long ago.

The Master's Glaive, to the south, is a place where such an old lord fell.

Go there and look for more Twilight's Hammer cultists.

Take this phial of scrying.  Use it to create a scrying bowl after searching the Master's Glaive.  Then speak to me through the bowl.
944-accept.title: The Master's Glaive

944-complete.name: Unknown
944-complete.text:
The Twilight's Hammer is at the Master's Glaive?

Unfortunate.

The old lord impaled by the glaive is long dead, but that does not mean slivers of his power do not still remain.

The Twilight's Hammer must be seeking this power.
944-complete.title: The Master's Glaive

944-progress.name: Unknown
944-progress.text:
The Master's Glaive, $N.

Go there, then speak with me again.
944-progress.title: The Master's Glaive

945-accept.name: Therylune
945-accept.text:
Help!

I was wandering around the Master's Glaive, and these dirty cultists surrounded me.  Lucky I'm good at hiding!!

Can you help me out of here?  And I need to send word to my sister Therysil that I'm all right.  She's in Ashenvale to the south, at the Shrine of Aessina.
945-accept.title: Therylune's Escape

945-complete.name: Therysil
945-complete.text:
My sister was where??  Therylune doesn't mind getting herself dirty, but still!  That's a long way to wander, and the Master's Glaive is an unwholesome place...

Well thank you, $N.  It was very nice of you to let me know she's all right.
945-complete.title: Therylune's Escape

948-complete.name: Onu
948-complete.text:
$N.  You are here.

Good.

We have matters...to discuss.  You and I.
948-complete.title: Onu

949-accept.name: Unknown
949-accept.text:
The Twilight's Hammer's purpose at the Master's Glaive is not known.  But it must be dark.

Search through their camp at the Glaive... Search for some thing that may teach us their intentions.

For we must learn their intentions before a plan is made.
949-accept.title: The Twilight Camp

949-complete.name: Unknown
949-complete.text: This book is hand printed in an ancient language, and illustrated by a master artist.
949-complete.title: The Twilight Camp

950-accept.name: Unknown
950-accept.text:
Peering into the Twilight Tome is maddening.  Text begins to swim and dance after only a moment's glance, and once beautiful scrollwork twists into grotesque shapes.

Tearing away one page of insane scribbles is all that is possible before a swoon overtakes you.
950-accept.title: Return to Onu

950-complete.name: Onu
950-complete.text:
A chaotic, primal magic surrounds this parchment of scribbles.  I sense the work of the old ones in it.

Let us hope it reveals the purpose of the Twilight's Hammer in Darkshore...
950-complete.title: Return to Onu

951-accept.name: Onu
951-accept.text:
The parchment you found at the Master's Glaive is a page from an ancient text...written by elves!  It is heavily cursed and tainted by the corruption of the Twilight's Hammer, but it seems the cult is using ancient elven magic to bring their old masters back to our world.

Travel to the ruins of Mathystra to the northeast, and search for ancient relics among the grass and broken stones.  Through their study, we may divine how the Twilight's Hammer intends to exploit the magic of the elves.
951-accept.title: Mathystra Relics

951-complete.name: Onu
951-complete.text:
Thank you.  These relics are from a time when Mathystra shone.  That once great bastion of the elves has faded, but shards of its magic remain.  Let us hope we can unlock the secrets of that place before our enemies...

Be vigilant, $N.
951-complete.title: Mathystra Relics

951-progress.name: Onu
951-progress.text: $N.  Has your rooting through the Ruins of Mathystra been fruitful?
951-progress.title: Mathystra Relics

965-complete.name: Balthule Shadowstrike
965-complete.text: Elissa sent you? Then it is good tidings you bring. I have troubling news to report to her, and had no means with which to deliver it.
965-complete.title: The Tower of Althalaxx

966-accept.name: Balthule Shadowstrike
966-accept.text:
A group of warlocks has taken up residence around and inside the tower. I would have returned to Auberdine to report to Elissa earlier, but I was afraid that I might miss something while I was away.

Delgren suspected such a company might be gathering at the tower, but did not know why.

A few scraps of parchment that the warlocks carry have found their way to my hands, but I need more to complete the puzzle. I warn you not to venture into the tower, however, the warlocks there are much more powerful!
966-accept.title: The Tower of Althalaxx

966-complete.name: Balthule Shadowstrike
966-complete.text:
Many thanks, $N. This should shed some light on this warlocks' gathering...

Hmm... the Cult of the Dark Strand... I have never heard of this group before. Having no knowledge of their history, it is all but impossible to say what their plans must be.

There is no more time to delay. Warning must be delivered to Delgren immediately.
966-complete.title: The Tower of Althalaxx

966-progress.name: Balthule Shadowstrike
966-progress.text: Have you found any more of their scrolls? I should be able to piece together a larger picture of the cult if you can find them.
966-progress.title: The Tower of Althalaxx

967-accept.name: Balthule Shadowstrike
967-accept.text:
My master, Delgren the Purifier, is a paladin who has graciously offered his assistance in defending our forests from the forces of the demons and undead. He has taught me much about the Holy Light and the art of battle.

Delgren must know of the cult's operations immediately.

You will find him far south of here at Maestra's Post in Ashenvale Forest. Be swift, I fear the Dark Strand's threat grows with each passing hour.
967-accept.title: The Tower of Althalaxx

967-complete.name: Delgren the Purifier
967-complete.text:
If you don't mind my saying, you seem a bit well-equipped for a messenger, hm? I suppose Balthule wanted to be certain that his letter reached my hands. Let's see what he has to say...

This is disturbing news. When undead or demonic forces are found, I help the Sentinels destroy them.

At first I was unaccustomed to the manners of the night elves, but I have grown to respect them greatly as allies.
967-complete.title: The Tower of Althalaxx

967-progress.name: Delgren the Purifier
967-progress.text: You have some business with me, $c?
967-progress.title: The Tower of Althalaxx

968-accept.name: Unknown
968-accept.text:
Although terribly worn and scratched, the title of this book can still be read upon its cover:

The Powers Below

Inside the book is a listing of unpronounceable names with foreboding titles, methods of worship, and preferred sacrifices...many of which include living, humanoid creatures.

On the inside cover of the book are the words: "Bonegrip's Runes and Dooms, The Forlorn Cavern, Ironforge.  Proprietor: Gerrig Bonegrip."

If Bonegrip sells books like this, perhaps he'll buy this one back.
968-accept.title: The Powers Below

970-accept.name: Delgren the Purifier
970-accept.text:
Balthule's letter is dire. This Cult of the Dark Strand is a thorn in my side that must be removed. I have been dealing with some of the Dark Strand scum northeast of here at Ordil'Aran. One of their number possesses a soul gem that I believe holds the secret to the cult's power.

Bring it to me, and I will be able to decipher the secrets held within.
970-accept.title: The Tower of Althalaxx

97220-accept.name: Manifest Clerk Philmor
97220-accept.text:
Every day this week we've been short dockhands.

Care to ease the stress on our cargo schedule?

Take this package to the stockroom entrance of the Gatehouse. You'll find it inside Trias' Cheese shop on the second floor. The mistress, Elaine, will be quite familiar with the deliveries. The Gatehouse often has shipments arriving with more discretion to allow for ceremonial surprises on behalf of the guard's officers.
97220-accept.title: Philmor's Favor

97220-complete.name: Elaine Trias
97220-complete.text: Oh, dear. You think we want to carry that up the stairs ourselves? Keeping the valuables intact is your responsibility up until the point you drop it off.
97220-complete.title: Philmor's Favor

97220-progress.name: Elaine Trias
97220-progress.text: You looking to fill a crate with our finest aged wheels?
97220-progress.title: Philmor's Favor

97222-accept.name: Elaine Trias
97222-accept.text:
Yes, it's only a flight of stairs, but if it's such a small ask, it should be no problem for you to finish the delivery yourself! 

Trias' Cheese isn't part of the Gatehouse or their stocking inventory, but our buildings share a floor.

Place the crate outside their stockroom door--the guard will send someone for a regular pickup. They will see the package arrival and carry it inside as they return to post.
97222-accept.title: Gatehouse Goods

97222-complete.name: Elaine Trias
97222-complete.text:
Yep. There's a reason that hinge opens inwards towards them, so they don't get the door blocked by people leaving stuff anywhere they please.

Consider us professionally acquainted, $c. 

We respect your business, and expect you to respect ours.
97222-complete.title: Gatehouse Goods

97914-complete.name: Baros Alexston
97914-complete.text: <Baros opens the letter and begins to read it, his smile fading.>
97914-complete.title: Expanding Horizons

97914-progress.name: Baros Alexston
97914-progress.text:
I can smell the sea on you, friend!

<Baros laughs.>

What brings you to Stormwind?
97914-progress.title: Expanding Horizons

97926-accept.name: Baros Alexston
97926-accept.text:
I wish it was that easy to help, $c. I really do.

Should you choose to spend more time in our lands, you will find that many are without. Stormwind's coffers are not what they once were, and what remains is spread thin.

Give this reply to the elder the next time you see him. It's not what he's hoping for, but it's all I have to offer right now.
97926-accept.title: Making Do

97926-complete.name: Thundris Windweaver
97926-complete.text:
Sad news indeed. Still, I thank you for making the journey.

With neither Stormwind nor Darnassus coming to aid us, it seems that Auberdine's fate is our own to decide.
97926-complete.title: Making Do

97926-progress.name: Thundris Windweaver
97926-progress.text: You have returned. What news comes from Stormwind?
97926-progress.title: Making Do

98013-accept.name: Arbal
98013-accept.text:
Steel yourself for your time in the ruins, young one... you will not be granted free passage there.

Scores of cursed Highborne, now known as naga, roam the once great city. Travel northeast and dispatch them from this land.

What they once were... is no more. If they aid the Twilight's Hammer, they can bring only further pain to the forests that once gave them shelter.

War is what they seek, $c. War... is what we will bring.
98013-accept.title: Swelling Forces

98042-accept.name: Reknit
98042-accept.text:
<As you tear away the single page from the Twilight Tome, a foreboding voice floods your mind, uninvited.>

They have failed.

You will be forgotten.

They will lose the eye they gained.
98042-accept.title: It's All Fun and Games Until...

98042-complete.name: Thundris Windweaver
98042-complete.text:
<Thundris does not speak for some time.>

This bears the mark of an ancient evil, $c. I will see it brought to Darnassus at once for further study.

Ande'thoras-ethil.
98042-complete.title: It's All Fun and Games Until...

98042-progress.name: Thundris Windweaver
98042-progress.text: You look troubled. I am listening.
98042-progress.title: It's All Fun and Games Until...

98461-complete.name: Tarrel Rockweaver
98461-complete.text:
<Tarrel reads the note.>

Oh... oh my. Poor Hollee.

She always did have a bit of a thing for me. And, truth be told, there was a time where I would have reciprocated. But I'm married. Happily married!

I think the best thing to do here is not to reply. I don't know how to let her down, and I have far more pressing things to worry about here! My wife is missing!
98461-complete.title: Unrequited Love

986-complete.name: Terenthis
986-complete.text:
These will do nicely, $N. I shall set to work on the cloak immediately.

Give me a few moments, then return to me.

Oh, one more thing: after you've used the enchantment on the cloak you'll be limited in your interactions with others. If you can help it, do no more than speak to others. Much more than that could dispel the illusion.
986-complete.title: A Lost Master

986-progress.name: Terenthis
986-progress.text: I can't in good conscience permit you to seek Volcor until I've crafted that cloak for you.
986-progress.title: A Lost Master

990-accept.name: Sentinel Selarin
990-accept.text:
$N, my mistress, Raene Wolfrunner, awaits you in the city of Astranaar within Ashenvale. With your help, perhaps we can at least ease some of the corruption that's taken hold there.

Head south from here and stay close to the road--you'll find your way there without issue if you follow those directions.
990-accept.title: Trek to Ashenvale

990-complete.name: Raene Wolfrunner
990-complete.text:
Ah, a $c from Darkshore. Selarin has done well to send you here so quickly, $N. I wish your trip here wasn't under such dire stress. Perhaps with your help we can improve matters.

I would start my visit by speaking to the other citizens of Astranaar. Some could surely use your aid.
990-complete.title: Trek to Ashenvale

993-accept.name: Terenthis
993-accept.text:
The cloak is complete, $N. The time has come to find Volcor. I can only hope we are in time.

The cloak's magic, once invoked, will not last long; perhaps five minutes. It will be up to you to know when to use it: I would suggest waiting until you find Grimclaw.

If what he has told me is true, you will find his master in a cave south of here. Grimclaw will be alongside the road waiting for you. Signal to him by waving when you see him, and he'll point the way towards his master.
993-accept.title: A Lost Master

993-complete.name: Volcor
993-complete.text:
Wonderful! Terenthis found someone to help me.

And look, a moonstalker cloak...<cough> Oh... that hurts. Thank you, $N.

The furbolgs wounded me before I managed to evade them. Give me a moment, and I should be fine to talk some more.
993-complete.title: A Lost Master

994-accept.name: Volcor
994-accept.text:
All right, $N, force it is. Let's get out of here as soon as you're ready. We'll fight our way down to the road--Grimclaw should still be there. Once there, we can part ways.

Terenthis will want to hear your version of the story immediately, so head to Auberdine after we make it out of here.
994-accept.title: Escape Through Force

994-complete.name: Terenthis
994-complete.text: $N! I'm pleased to see you've returned successfully. Your assistance to Volcor has given me faith that we can overcome the challenges facing us here in Darkshore and beyond.
994-complete.title: Escape Through Force

995-accept.name: Volcor
995-accept.text:
All right then... if you're sure, we'll sneak out of here. Let us leave when you're ready.

Remember, after you've escaped, meet Terenthis back in Auberdine. I'll head there on my own since I'll probably be moving faster than you.
995-accept.title: Escape Through Stealth
